title: Perfectly Chilled Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Perfectly Chilled is a 4 BR / 3.5 BA / 11 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. With its amazing surroundings, generous inclusions and tree topping observation deck, the ‘Perfectly Chilled’ cottage fits the bill when it comes to one of Seaside’s most relaxing vacation homes.
description_expanded: Description61 Venice Circle1 KING, 3 QUEEN, BUNKROOM THAT SLEEPS 3A Relaxed Seaside Retreat with Panoramic Gulf ViewsTucked into the heart of East Seaside, Florida, Perfectly Chilled is a thoughtfully designed coastal cottage offering one of the most relaxing vacation experiences along Scenic Highway 30A. Surrounded by iconic Seaside architecture and just steps from the area’s most beloved amenities, this four-story home blends laid-back beach living with elevated comfort. From its generous inclusions to its tree-top observation tower overlooking the Gulf, Perfectly Chilled lives up to its name in every way.Prime Location in East SeasideThis pastel-hued Seaside cottage is ideally located near popular shops, dining, and beach access, placing guests within easy walking distance of everything that makes Seaside special. Whether you’re heading to the beach, strolling through town, or enjoying nearby green spaces, the location offers the perfect balance of convenience and coastal charm. The observation deck at the top of the home provides breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico, making it a standout feature among Seaside vacation rentals.Bright Interiors Designed for Comfort and GatheringStep inside to discover a bright, welcoming interior filled with natural light and coastal warmth. The main living level features a comfortable living area, a dedicated dining space, and a well-appointed kitchen designed for both everyday ease and family gatherings. The kitchen is finished with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, generous cabinetry, and an oversized pantry, offering ample space to prepare meals after a day at the beach.Private Bedrooms for Restful Seaside NightsThe second level is dedicated to rest and relaxation, featuring a serene primary bedroom suite with an en suite bath complete with double vanities and a walk-in shower. A private deck off the suite offers a quiet spot to enjoy morning coffee beneath the coastal breeze. This floor also includes an additional queen bedroom, a twin bunk room, and a full shared bath—perfect for families traveling together.On the third level, guests will find a spacious bedroom with two queen beds and a private en suite bath, along with a conveniently located laundry room for extended stays.A Signature Tower with Unmatched Gulf ViewsThe crown jewel of Perfectly Chilled is its refinished observation tower, accessed by a spiral staircase. This covered, elevated space offers sweeping Gulf views above the treetops—an ideal setting for sunset cocktails, morning relaxation, or simply soaking in the sights and sounds of Seaside. It’s here that guests truly understand what it means to stay Perfectly Chilled.* Please be advised that Perfectly Chilled is equipped with an active front door Ring bell as well as a security video cam in the backyard. * 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3-night minimum Fall; 2-night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES1,896 square feet4-minute walk, 352 yards to beach accessPrivate Seaside residential beach at Savannah Pavilion, featuring one of the largest private beaches on 30ASteps from the Seaside Fitness CenterConvenient access to both adult and family swimming poolsFull-size washer and dryerPeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homesA golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR23-002034
